about.en:
Doha Model United Nations is organised by Student Affairs and Community Engagement within Qatar Foundation's Pre-University Education, the network behind schools such as Qatar Academy. It is one of the few conferences in the Gulf that runs committees in both Arabic and English, so it is a natural first or second MUN for students in Qatar and the region.

The conference runs 26–29 January 2027 in Doha, Qatar at Qatar Academy Senior School, Education City and is aimed at high school students. Working language: English and Arabic (bilingual committees). Committees and topics are published on the official website before the conference.

Participation is school-based: schools register delegations, and students can join as delegates, student officers/chairs or members of the conference team. Fees are not published on the website; ask through your school's MUN coordinator. Delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions, which builds public speaking, research and negotiation skills valued by universities.

about.en:
Future We Want Model United Nations (FWWMUN) is an international MUN series run by the Future We Want Global Initiative for Young Leaders. The Abu Dhabi edition brings together high school and university delegations from around the world, with committees grouped by level so that younger delegates debate with their peers.

The conference runs 18–21 March 2027 in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates at Millennium Downtown Abu Dhabi (5-star hotel) and is aimed at high school and university students (high school delegates aged 13–19, university delegates aged 17–26). Working language: English. Committees: High school: Security Council, General Assembly (GA1–GA3), UNEA, ECOFIN, UNHCR, HRC, CCPCJ, DISEC, CSW, HLPF, UNESCO, SOCHUM, WHA, Legal, SPECPOL, ECOSOC; university: similar set plus UNDP.

Schools register as delegations of at least five delegates; high-school delegations need a faculty advisor (one per five delegates). Position papers are due 22 Feb 2027. An optional certified diplomacy training is offered at extra cost. Delegates research their assigned country, write position papers, give speeches, negotiate in caucuses and draft resolutions, which builds public speaking, research and negotiation skills valued by universities.
